title: Discovery of Substituted 5-(2-Hydroxybenzoyl)-2-Pyridone Analogues as Inhibitors of the Human Caf1/CNOT7 Ribonuclease.
authors: Kaur, Ishwinder; Jadhav, Gopal P; Fischer, Peter M; Winkler, Gerlof Sebastiaan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂对Caf1/CNOT7核糖核酸酶的抑制，虽涉及蛋白-核酸酶体系与分子对接，但对象为RNA核酸酶而非DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The Caf1/CNOT7 nuclease is a catalytic component of the Ccr4-Not deadenylase complex, which is a key regulator of post-transcriptional gene regulation. In addition to providing catalytic activity, Caf1/CNOT7 and its paralogue Caf1/CNOT8 also contribute a structural function by mediating interactions between the large, non-catalytic subunit CNOT1, which forms the backbone of the Ccr4-Not complex and the second nuclease subunit Ccr4 (CNOT6/CNOT6L). To facilitate investigations into the role of Caf1/CNOT7 in gene regulation, we aimed to discover and develop non-nucleoside inhibitors of the enzyme. Here, we disclose that the tri-substituted 2-pyridone compound 5-(5-bromo-2-hydroxy-benzoyl)-1-(4-chloro-2-methoxy-5-methyl-phenyl)-2-oxo-pyridine-3-carbonitrile is an inhibitor of the Caf1/CNOT7 nuclease. Using a fluorescence-based nuclease assay, the activity of 16 structural analogues was determined, which predominantly explored substituents on the 1-phenyl group. While no compound with higher potency was identified among this set of structural analogues, the lowest potency was observed with the analogue lacking substituents on the 1-phenyl group. This indicates that substituents on the 1-phenyl group contribute significantly to binding. To identify possible binding modes of the inhibitors, molecular docking was carried out. This analysis suggested that the binding modes of the five most potent inhibitors may display similar conformations upon binding active site residues. Possible interactions include pi-pi interactions with His225, hydrogen bonding with the backbone of Phe43 and Van der Waals interactions with His225, Leu209, Leu112 and Leu115.
abstract_zh: Caf1/CNOT7核酸酶是Ccr4-Not去腺苷酸酶复合物的催化组分，该复合物是转录后基因调控的关键调节因子。除了提供催化活性外，Caf1/CNOT7及其旁系同源物Caf1/CNOT8还通过介导大型非催化亚基CNOT1（构成Ccr4-Not复合物的骨架）与第二个核酸酶亚基Ccr4（CNOT6/CNOT6L）之间的相互作用，发挥结构功能。为促进对Caf1/CNOT7在基因调控中作用的研究，我们旨在发现并开发该酶的非核苷类抑制剂。在此，我们揭示三取代2-吡啶酮化合物5-(5-溴-2-羟基苯甲酰基)-1-(4-氯-2-甲氧基-5-甲基苯基)-2-氧代吡啶-3-腈是Caf1/CNOT7核酸酶的抑制剂。利用基于荧光的核酸酶测定法，确定了16种结构类似物的活性，这些类似物主要探索了1-苯基上的取代基。虽然在这组结构类似物中未发现效力更高的化合物，但观察到缺乏1-苯基取代基的类似物效力最低。这表明1-苯基上的取代基对结合有显著贡献。为识别抑制剂可能的结合模式，进行了分子对接 (molecular docking)。该分析提示，五种效力最强的抑制剂的结合模式在与活性位点残基结合时可能呈现相似构象。可能的相互作用包括与His225的pi-pi相互作用、与Phe43主链的氢键作用以及与His225、Leu209、Leu112和Leu115的范德华相互作用。
